user_query: I'm planning a family game night and I want to include educational activities. Can you share some trivia facts about numbers that are suitable for different age groups? Additionally, recommend a music trivia game that can be enjoyed by the whole family.

TaskList.description: Gather trivia facts about numbers suitable for different age groups.
Research and recommend a family-friendly music trivia game.
Compile the trivia facts and recommended game into a single document or list.
